executiveProfile: AI systems architect, software engineer, and MBA-trained technology strategist who moves from problem definition through architecture, implementation, deployment, and validation. Builds production applications and governance-oriented AI systems across knowledge work, commerce, inspection, decision support, and research, with a consistent emphasis on auditability, provenance, deterministic controls, and human judgment.

highlights: Lead a portfolio of AI, software, knowledge-system, education, media, and operational ventures from concept through deployment.
Architect Python and TypeScript systems that combine probabilistic AI with deterministic workflows, provenance controls, testing, and human review.
Translate emerging AI capabilities into product architecture, governance frameworks, technical documentation, operating standards, and validation plans.
Designed operational software and repeatable workflows for FAA Part 107 aerial inspection, evidence capture, visual and thermal reporting, and client documentation.
Built quality-assurance and service-boundary practices around remote sensing, thermal imaging, RTK mapping, reporting, and infrastructure documentation.
Bring more than a decade of drone flight experience to field operations, product design, and inspection-system development.
Advise on technology modernization, process improvement, AI adoption, organizational design, and operational effectiveness.
Convert ambiguous business problems into workflows, standards, technical requirements, decision-support tools, and implementation plans.
